info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Risk Models Management API
info.description: The Operational Risk Models Management API enables financial institutions to create and manage operational risk models efficiently. This API allows users to submit new models, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and enhancing risk assessment capabilities. Typical consumers include risk managers and compliance officers who need to develop robust risk management frameworks. Through this API, organizations can streamline their model development processes while ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of operational risks.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new operational risk model by providing the necessary details in the request body. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to facilitate the model creation process.
